sentences.text:
This first bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No. 445/2023 registered at Police Station Gwalior, District Gwalior (M.P.)
for the offence punishable under Sections 420 of the IPC.

As per case of the prosecution, Sudha Singh submitted a written complaint with SHO, PS Gwalior inter-alia alleging that on 29/03/2023 she went to Raghav Online Centre at Tansen Nagar to update her PAN Card and Aadhar Card.
She and her daughter-in-law were asked to submit their fingers print on machine.

sentences.text: 1 Rs. 17,650/- from account of her husband have been withdrawn.
She suspects that Manager of Raghav Online Centre has committed some mischief and withdrawn amount from their bank accounts.

On such allegations, Police Station - Gwalior District Gwalior registered FIR at Crime No.
445/2023 for the offence punishable under Section 420 of the IPC.
The matter is under investigation.

The Investigation Officer- Upendra, Inspector of Police Station Gwalior District Gwalior appeared before this Court and submitted that amount was withdrawn from the account of complainant and her family members through online mobile banking system and they could trace the account wherein these amounts have been forwarded as Airtel payment bank account of Arvind Kumar s/o Rajendra Kumar resident of Samastipur, Bihar.
The investigation is underway.

Further, one Rinki Devi and Aadharika, resident of Begusarai, Bihar also appeared to be involved in the matter but no evidence is found against applicant Arvind Rajpoot in the investigation at present stage.
The Investigation Officer further submits that, if required, he will issue notice under Section 41 of the Cr.P.C to the applicant for the purpose of investigation.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties.
At this stage, learned counsel for the applicant requests to withdraw this application.

He further requests that a direction may be issued to the Investigation Officer to comply with the directions of the Supreme Court in cases of Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar (2014) 8 SCC 273, Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of investigation (2022) 10 SCC 51 and Notification No. A/5666/III-2-9/40 Pt-I F.No.15 dated 20/09/2023 issued by Hon'ble High Court of Madhya Pradesh, Jabalpur.
